name: Nida's Necklace
summary: Nida's Necklace is a cherished childhood keepsake lost beneath the surface of Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains. Given to young Nida by her father, the trinket slipped into the murky waters while the children of Lakeshire were out fishing along the docks.

sections.title: Lost in the Depths
sections.body: While fishing along the shoreline of Lakeshire with her friend Shawn, young Nida accidentally dropped her treasured necklace into Lake Everstill. The heirloom holds immense sentimental value, having been a gift from her father. Fear of the fierce beasts and aggressive murlocs inhabiting the depths keeps the local children safely on the docks, leaving the necklace sunken and buried in the silt of the lakebed until an adventurer is willing to dive into the murky water to recover it.

faq.q: Who does this necklace belong to?
faq.answer: The necklace belongs to Nida, a young girl living in the town of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. It was a special present given to her by her father.

faq.q: How did the necklace end up in Lake Everstill?
aliases: how did it get in the lake
faq.answer: Nida was spending the day fishing near the water with her companion Shawn when the necklace slipped off and sank into the lakebed, settling into a mound of glinting mud.

faq.q: Why didn't the children dive in to get it back?
aliases: why didn't nida swim for it
why can't shawn get the necklace
faq.answer: Their parents strictly forbid them from swimming in Lake Everstill. The deep waters harbor dangerous aquatic predators and aggressive murlocs that pose a lethal threat to the local townspeople.
Effsee is Nida's pet cat, who stays by her side in Lakeshire and happily welcomes the necklace's return alongside its young owner.

angles.text: Lakeshire's defenders are stretched thin against surrounding threats, leaving small acts of kindness—like helping local children recover lost keepsakes—to traveling Alliance adventurers.
